# FG-GIT-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `concurrency_limit_reports_git_busy` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Git の処理が混み合っています。しばらくしてから再度お試しください。
- en: The Git backend is busy. Try again later.
- id: Layanan Git sedang sibuk. Coba lagi nanti.

## 原因 (cause)

Every git subprocess slot was in use for longer than the acquire timeout, or a principal already holds its maximum number of streams.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Without `reason`: the captured pool (`GitConfig::max_concurrency`). `reason=streams`: the streaming pool for Smart HTTP (`max_streams`, default 16) — long clones hold slots. `reason=principal_streams`: one principal (user or client address) already has `max_per_principal` (default 4) streams open; refused at once. `reason=body_reads` / `principal_body_reads` (forge-web, M1 phase 9 MR3): every Smart HTTP request-body read slot is taken (sized like the stream pool: `git.http.max_streams` in total, waited for up to `acquire_timeout`, `wait_ms`) or this user already reads `git.http.max_streams_per_principal` bodies (`max`, refused at once) — many slow or stalled uploads at the same time. `reason=repo_browse` (with `repo_id`, `max_per_repo`; M2 MR7): one repository already runs `BrowseLimits::max_per_repo` (default 8) captured browse calls; refused at once — with `check=reachability` it was the check that a commit named by id is reachable (M3 P6): not treated as reachable, logged as `forge.git.browse.reach_undecided` and answered to the user as FG-REPO-0023 `ref_not_found` (`reach_error=FG-GIT-0004`). `reason=caller_reach_rate` (with `burst`, `refill_ms`) / `reason=caller_reach` (with `max`, `wait_ms`): one caller made more commit-id browse lookups than its token bucket allows (`BrowseLimits::reach_caller_burst` 60, one back per `reach_caller_refill` 250 ms) or already runs `reach_per_caller` (2) of them and none finished within `reach_caller_wait` (2 s) — counted before the id is looked at, so missing and existing ids are refused alike (M3 P6, ADR-0024 #37). Usually a script walking commit ids; the UI browses by branch name. Compare with the number of concurrent clones/pushes in the access log.

## 対処 (fix)

Raise the git concurrency limit if the host has CPU and IO headroom, or find the operations that hold slots for long.
